## lately-d24 after Humu's death — lately with Brian (d24)
> YOU PICK [gq:yn:yes] 
YOU: "Yes."
NPC: They nod. "Okay."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Hold on, back up. Then what?"
NPC: Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me about them."
NPC: "It's my grandmother, Anna. Was taken. Eighty-one years old and they called her boring. Eighty-one years. Some nights I dream about the pods -- rows of them, humming. I wake up and I can't tell if it was a dream or a broadcast."

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I'll ask the System about the pods."
NPC: "You'd do that? Ask it? ...Thank you. Really. Even asking is more than the silence."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Hold on, back up. Then what?"
NPC: "Help me haul something back? Too much for one."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on what was on their mind."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Hold on, back up. Then what?"
NPC: "What do you miss most? From before."

> YOU PICK [ans:q_miss:a_food] 
YOU: "A real hot meal."
NPC: "God. Yes. I dream about soup. Actual soup, with a spoon. Not that it matters."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:show]
